_schema.description: Human- or agent-reviewed theory threads. Similarity alone must not create milestones or links.

thread-charlie-kirk-assassination-altern.title: How alternative Charlie Kirk assassination theories evolved
thread-charlie-kirk-assassination-altern.summary: A single reviewed branching timeline of on-channel alternatives to the lone-actor account, including proposed participants, operational evidence, motive claims, and alleged coverup indicators. It records how theories changed, not whether they are true.

milestones.proposition: Owens first described the retreat in this corpus as a staged intervention organized because Kirk's views on Israel were unacceptable to participants.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly supports that Owens made this characterization and attributed it to what she had been told. This milestone records the on-channel assertion, not independent proof that the retreat was an intervention.
milestones.label: Intervention account

milestones.proposition: Cox said Robinson had not confessed to authorities and was not cooperating.
milestones.review_note: The embedded interview directly supports the narrow claim about a confession to authorities at that time.
milestones.label: No authority confession

milestones.proposition: The probable-cause account said DNA consistent with Robinson was found on the recovered rifles trigger.
milestones.review_note: The episode reads the charging account and directly attributes this physical-evidence claim to it.
milestones.label: Trigger DNA

milestones.proposition: Cox said a family member reported that Robinson had confessed or implied responsibility to them.
milestones.review_note: The press-conference clip reports a secondhand family account. It expands, rather than erases, the earlier distinction about confession to authorities.
milestones.label: Family report

milestones.proposition: Owens read Andrew Kolvet's statement that a surgeon said the bullet should have passed through but Kirk's body stopped it and the bullet was found beneath the skin.
milestones.review_note: The episode directly reads Kolvet's public account. This milestone records the attributed explanation, not an independent medical finding.
milestones.label: Surgeon quote published

milestones.proposition: Owens relayed an unnamed sources claim that the bullet was too fragmented to match to Robinsons rifle.
milestones.review_note: The transcript clearly attributes the statement to an unnamed source. This milestone records that on-channel limitation without independently validating it.
milestones.label: Fragmentation claim

milestones.proposition: DuRousseau preserved the moral-pressure account but described Kirk as objecting to emotional arguments about Israel in a debate setting.
milestones.review_note: The direct clip supports the moral-blackmail and debate framing. This repairs a stale pre-migration statement reference without treating the account as independent proof of what happened.
milestones.label: Debate workshop

milestones.proposition: Owens asserted that Egyptian military personnel were in Utah on the day Charlie Kirk was killed.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records Owens making the claim and demanding identities and a purpose; it does not independently verify who was on the ground.
milestones.label: Personnel in Utah

milestones.proposition: Owens said her investigation had expanded from the September 10 flight to a finding that the two Egyptian planes had been tracking Charlie Kirk.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records the expansion of Owens's theory; the milestone does not treat the asserted tracking pattern as independently established.
milestones.label: Tracking Charlie branch

milestones.proposition: Owens said the Egyptian group did not depart on SU-BTT and instead waited for a second Egyptian aircraft, SU-BND, to take them home.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records the asserted passenger movement as a new operational detail; it does not identify the passengers or their purpose.
milestones.label: Return-flight branch

milestones.proposition: Harpole said his team could not fly a drone because UVU lay in controlled Provo airspace and additional restrictions may have applied.
milestones.review_note: The embedded Harpole clip directly records the airspace explanation and his statement that the team could not break the rules.
milestones.label: Flights restricted

milestones.proposition: Turek said the team had drones above the crowd before the event and texted footage to Kirk in the car.
milestones.review_note: The embedded Turek clip directly supplies a competing account of drone footage before the event; it does not identify which team role operated the drone.
milestones.label: Pre-event footage

milestones.proposition: Owens said private booking records placed the witness at the Fort Huachuca hotel on September 8.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records Owens describing booking, timestamp, reservation, and call-log material. It supports the witness's location, not whom he later said he recognized.
milestones.label: Witness placed on base

milestones.proposition: Owens relayed that the witness was certain he saw Brian Harpole while repeatedly stressing that she could not confirm the identification.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly contains both parts of the account: the witness's certainty and Owens's explicit attribution caveat.
milestones.label: Harpole identification relayed

milestones.proposition: Owens disputed that a human neck could stop a .30-06 round in the manner being described.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records Owens challenging the physical plausibility of the account and asking for any comparable example.
milestones.label: Feasibility disputed

milestones.proposition: Owens broadened the alleged pattern to say the planes repeatedly appeared around Turning Point USA faith events and around Erika and Charlie Kirk.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly frames the alleged overlaps as a statistical anomaly while demanding an explanation; this records the broader theory, not statistical validation.
milestones.label: Erika and Charlie pattern

milestones.proposition: Owens stated unequivocally that the steel-neck quotation did not come from surgeon Lee Trotter.
milestones.review_note: The transcript explicitly puts the earlier surgeon-attribution branch to rest within the channel's narrative. It does not independently adjudicate the medical facts.
milestones.label: Surgeon attribution refuted

milestones.proposition: Owens said the surgeon did not confirm a .30-06 or a steel-neck explanation and instead suggested a frangible bullet as a possibility.
milestones.review_note: The episode directly distinguishes the later account of what the surgeon suggested from the wording previously attributed to him.
milestones.label: Frangible bullet branch

milestones.proposition: In a direct interview, Mitch Snow said he was 95–99 percent certain that the man he saw at the meeting was Brian Harpole.
milestones.review_note: The witness directly states the basis and uncertainty range for his identification; the milestone does not treat that identification as independently verified.
milestones.label: Harpole branch

milestones.proposition: Snow separately said he was 95–99 percent certain he saw Erika Kirk in the hotel lobby the night before the meeting.
milestones.review_note: The direct interview supports the attributed identification and its stated confidence; it does not independently prove that Kirk was present.
milestones.label: Erika branch

milestones.proposition: Owens said military-police incident reports proved Snow's account that he was at Fort Huachuca and encountered police.
milestones.review_note: The episode directly makes the proof claim about the incident reports. Those records address presence and the police encounter, not the identities Snow said he saw.
milestones.label: Presence evidence added

milestones.proposition: Owens said Erika Kirk disputed the narrative that she had been at Fort Huachuca.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly reports Kirk's competing position through Owens; it is not presented as an independently documented alibi.
milestones.label: Erika disputes presence

milestones.proposition: A TPUSA lawyer distinguished prohibited security-drone use during the event from a permitted media-production flight that gathered limited B-roll beforehand.
milestones.review_note: The quoted letter addresses both prior accounts by separating the drone operator, purpose, and time window.
milestones.label: Role distinction

milestones.proposition: Owens said she had become convinced the planes were Israeli-operated and that activity was being routed through Egypt.
milestones.review_note: The interview directly records Owens's conclusion. It remains an attributed theory rather than an independently verified ownership finding.
milestones.label: Israeli-routing branch

milestones.proposition: Seth Dillon disputed the intervention framing and said Kirk personally convened and led the retreat, while confirming a heated debate about Israel occurred.
milestones.review_note: The clip directly records Dillon rejecting the intervention description and offering a competing participant account. It contradicts the staging claim while corroborating that Israel was debated.
milestones.label: Convened by Kirk

milestones.proposition: A defense filing said the ATF summary could not identify the autopsy bullets to the rifle associated with Robinson.
milestones.review_note: Owens reads the filing language on air; it supports a narrower no-identification result rather than a conclusion that the rifle was excluded.
milestones.label: No bullet identification

milestones.proposition: The released ATF summary said the recovered cartridge case matched the rifle associated with Robinson.
milestones.review_note: The episode reads the ATF result and distinguishes the cartridge-case match from the separate bullet-fragment analysis.
milestones.label: Cartridge case match

milestones.proposition: The same ATF summary said bullet-jacket fragments could neither be identified nor excluded as having been fired from the rifle.
milestones.review_note: The direct reading supplies the precise inconclusive finding and prevents the cartridge-case match from being generalized to the bullet fragments.
milestones.label: Fragments inconclusive

milestones.proposition: Owens reiterated that she could confirm Snow's location, timing, incident, and metadata but not the identities he claimed to recognize.
milestones.review_note: The episode replays and restates the earlier caveat, explicitly narrowing what Owens said her evidence established.
milestones.label: Identities remain unconfirmed

milestones.proposition: Owens read a message claiming a TPUSA source had documents proving Harpole and Kirk were not at Fort Huachuca.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records the message as a source claim. The underlying documents were not supplied in this statement, so this remains a competing attributed account.
milestones.label: TPUSA alibi branch

milestones.proposition: Owens later presented two possibilities: Egyptian VIPs traveling during regional conflict or Israeli VIPs using Egyptian aircraft, as had occurred historically.
milestones.review_note: The transcript explicitly presents alternatives and conditional language, narrowing the earlier categorical ownership claim to competing hypotheses.
milestones.label: VIP-use possibilities

milestones.proposition: Owens later said a trusted source told her Erika Kirk joined the surgeon call and originated the Superman-neck explanation.
milestones.review_note: The direct interview clearly attributes this source-of-wording claim to Owens and an unnamed source; the source account is not independently verified here.
milestones.label: Origin attributed to Erika

milestones.proposition: Deace characterized the record as containing three confessions: to Robinsons parents, to his roommate, and on Discord.
milestones.review_note: The clip directly records Deaces broader characterization; this milestone tracks what he told the audience, not the legal status of those alleged confessions.
milestones.label: Three-confession claim

milestones.proposition: Owens argued that Robinson agreed to surrender to avoid a forced entry and did not thereby confess.
milestones.review_note: Owens explicitly distinguishes a voluntary surrender from a confession and presents this as a rebuttal to the three-confessions account.
milestones.label: Surrender, not confession

milestones.proposition: Owens said she believed Robinson was involved in Kirk's killing but explicitly rejected the idea that he acted alone.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records Owens's qualified belief about Robinson and her explicit rejection of a lone-actor account; it does not establish that belief as fact.
milestones.label: Involved, not alone

milestones.proposition: Owens alleged that the published Robinson–Twiggs message excerpts were doctored after her producer pointed out ellipses and omitted context.
milestones.review_note: The transcript supports the attributed allegation and its immediate basis in visible ellipses; this seed does not independently prove alteration or identify who prepared the excerpts.
milestones.label: Messages alleged doctored

milestones.proposition: Owens relayed that members of Lance Twiggs's family did not accept the current account and believed more people were involved.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly supports Owens's attribution to unnamed family members. It records their reported view, not independent corroboration of a wider plot.
milestones.label: Family doubts lone actor

milestones.proposition: Owens broadened the alternative account into an explicit claim that more people were involved and that the shooting felt like a conspiracy.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records this as Owens's stated assessment after discussing unusual traffic, George Zinn, family doubts, and missing message context; it is not an independently verified conclusion.
milestones.label: Wider plot asserted

milestones.proposition: Owens expanded the wider-plot theory by alleging federal-level corruption and conspiracy in Kirk's murder.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly supports that Owens made this allegation while challenging image quality, message disclosure, and other federal investigative choices; it does not prove federal involvement.
milestones.label: Federal conspiracy alleged

milestones.proposition: Owens said the alleged federal conspiracy might include someone close to Kirk.
milestones.review_note: The transcript preserves Owens's explicit uncertainty ('maybe') and occurs immediately after she challenged a close pastor to disclose the names of people who had intimidated Kirk; it records a possibility, not an identification.
milestones.label: Close associate possibility

milestones.proposition: Owens narrowed her overarching theory to multiple participants, explicitly including George Zinn and saying Robinson played an unknown part.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records Owens calling this her theory, naming Zinn, and preserving uncertainty about Robinson's role; it does not establish either person's involvement.
milestones.label: Zinn and Robinson roles

milestones.proposition: Owens expanded the doctored-message theory by arguing that wording such as 'squad car' and 'outfit' suggested the excerpts were authored by federal agents rather than Robinson.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records Owens's inference and the wording she relied on. The linguistic stereotypes are not independent evidence of authorship.
milestones.label: Federal authorship alleged

milestones.proposition: Owens suggested federal agents collected local footage and discouraged public sharing in order to control the case narrative.
milestones.review_note: The transcript supports this as Owens's inference after relaying local reports about federal instructions; it does not independently establish why footage was collected.
milestones.label: Footage-control theory

milestones.proposition: Owens presented an alleged 6:38 p.m. Dairy Queen photo as conflicting with the official outfit-change timeline because the person wore a maroon shirt with jeans.
milestones.review_note: The transcript preserves Owens's repeated caveat that the photo and date were alleged. This milestone records the claimed inconsistency, not authentication of the image.
milestones.label: Outfit anomaly

milestones.proposition: Owens relayed a local theory that Robinson was instructed only to drop off the gun while a different shooter escaped into a nearby vacant university-owned house.
milestones.review_note: The transcript explicitly labels this 'full theory zone,' says there was no proof, and attributes it to local residents. The milestone preserves those limitations.
milestones.label: Dropoff and safe house

milestones.proposition: Owens relayed a further local theory that Robinson and Twiggs may have been blackmailed or threatened into transporting the weapon.
milestones.review_note: The transcript repeatedly identifies this as unproven local speculation rather than Owens's own theory. It remains a dormant lead pending later evidence.
milestones.label: Blackmail coercion seed

milestones.proposition: Owens presented footage showing a TPUSA-affiliated staffer remove the camera above Kirk's seat and appear to remove its SD card shortly after the shooting.
milestones.review_note: The transcript supports what Owens said the footage appeared to show and her identification of the person as long associated with TPUSA. It does not by itself establish improper intent.
milestones.label: Camera card removed

milestones.proposition: The staffer told Owens he removed the camera footage to secure it and hand it to federal investigators.
milestones.review_note: Owens directly relayed the staffer's prompt explanation and described him as forthcoming. This provides a benign evidence-handling account without independently verifying chain of custody.
milestones.label: Evidence-security explanation

milestones.proposition: Owens alleged that federal actors were involved in Kirk's death to create a crisis that could be used to expand government power and speech restrictions.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records this as Owens's political-motive theory and immediately compares it to post-9/11 power expansion. It is an allegation, not verified causation.
milestones.label: Policy motive alleged

milestones.proposition: Owens said many early viral eyewitness videos came from people with government or TPUSA ties rather than random UVU students.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records Owens's claimed pattern but does not, by itself, show coordination or participation in the assassination. It remains a dormant narrative-control lead.
milestones.label: Viral-source ties

milestones.proposition: Owens relayed an eyewitness account that the rooftop shooter wore tactical gear and a face mask rather than the jeans associated with Robinson.
milestones.review_note: The transcript clearly attributes the observation to one eyewitness and records Owens's questions. It is a reported account, not independently authenticated identification.
milestones.label: Tactical shooter account

milestones.proposition: The same eyewitness reportedly characterized the shooter as resembling a highly trained foreign agent or assassin.
milestones.review_note: The transcript preserves Owens's uncertainty about how the witness inferred foreign status and attributes the assessment to his firearms experience. This remains a dormant identification theory.
milestones.label: Foreign-agent seed

milestones.proposition: Kolvet said team members removed SD cards to prevent theft and preserve the footage for law enforcement.
milestones.review_note: The direct clip supports Kolvet's stated rationale. It corroborates the earlier staffer explanation as an organizational account, not independent chain-of-custody proof.
milestones.label: Team secures SD cards

milestones.proposition: Owens said she heard a police-scanner call describing a masked suspect in a black vest carrying a long rifle, partly matching the eyewitness's tactical-gear account.
milestones.review_note: The transcript records a viewer restating the call and Owens saying she had heard it. This is on-channel corroboration of clothing details, not independent verification of the scanner audio.
milestones.label: Scanner tactical description

milestones.proposition: Owens said a well-placed source told her the FBI was pressuring Utah authorities to close the case and rule it a lone-gunman shooting.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly supports Owens's attribution to an unnamed authoritative source and the alleged prosecution rationale. It does not independently verify that pressure occurred.
milestones.label: Lone-gunman pressure

milestones.proposition: Owens said the rooftop videographer did not think Robinson was the shooter and described different clothing and a different gun.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly attributes the assessment to the same firearms-experienced eyewitness. It remains one reported witness account, not a verified exclusion.
milestones.label: Eyewitness rejects Tyler

milestones.proposition: Owens relayed a source claim that federal investigators lacked footage explaining how the rifle reached the roof.
milestones.review_note: The transcript preserves the claim's source attribution and separates it from Owens's reaction. This records an alleged evidentiary gap, not a verified inventory of investigative footage.
milestones.label: Rifle route unexplained

milestones.proposition: Owens read a viewer tip alleging that omitted neighborhood footage showed Robinson changing clothes with an unidentified woman present.
milestones.review_note: The transcript shows Owens immediately requesting the footage and treating the report as an unconfirmed tip. It remains a dormant potential-accomplice lead.
milestones.label: Unidentified woman seed

milestones.proposition: Owens said TPUSA would not publicly release its footage of Kirk's shooting and argued that release could address suspicions about the camera handling.
milestones.review_note: The transcript supports the non-release claim and Owens's explicit caution that it did not make every employee guilty. It remains a dormant organizational-coverup lead.
milestones.label: TPUSA footage withheld

milestones.proposition: Owens said her longstanding instinct was that federal authorities entered the case immediately to stage a coverup.
milestones.review_note: The transcript directly records this as Owens's instinct while discussing missing updates about Twiggs and the federal investigation. It is an accusation, not verified conduct.
milestones.label: Coverup staging claim

milestones.proposition: Owens relayed insider claims that Kirk believed money was disappearing from TPUSA and had begun investigating organizational finances shortly before his death.
milestones.review_note: The transcript repeatedly attributes the concern to insiders and presents a September 2 internal memo as a starting point. It does not connect any financial issue to the assassination, so this remains a dormant motive seed.
milestones.label: Finance concern seed

milestones.proposition: Owens repeated the omitted-footage claim, said she had established contact with the tipster, and described the unidentified-woman report as a solid lead in a possible local coverup.
milestones.review_note: The transcript shows the lead advanced from a live viewer comment to direct contact, but no footage was presented in this source and the alleged woman's identity remained unknown.
milestones.label: Woman lead advanced

milestones.proposition: Owens said the cartridge-case etchings felt suspicious and were beginning to resemble a government signature.
milestones.review_note: The transcript records this as a tentative reaction to a viewer comment, without evidentiary support or identification of an actor. It remains a dormant coverup seed.
milestones.label: Etching signature seed
